description: Fork of exp071 (val=1.7088 @ 8K, rank-only chain, 129.30M params). Same architecture, same config, only n_steps 8000 -> 24000 (3x longer training). Tests whether the rank-canonicalize architecture continues to improve past 8K or plateaus. exp061 (un-canonicalized baseline) reached 1.7181 @ 8K; this run is the long-budget answer for the rank-only end-to-end pipeline.
